   452	/// The capacities that the last `grow_hint_pages` full pages before the
   453	/// last one needed for styles, graphemes, strings, and hyperlinks,
   454	/// measured by `utilizationCapacity` when `grow` moved past each of
   455	/// them. `grow` gives each new page the largest of these and what the
   456	/// page that just filled needed, so a new page reflects the last few
   457	/// full pages instead of only the last one. See `growCapacity` for why.
   458	///
   459	/// This is a ring: `grow_hint_next` is the slot the next need goes in.
   460	/// Slots are null until that many pages have filled up, and `reset`
   461	/// clears them. `growHint` combines them.

   490	/// store the offset from the top because it doesn't change while more

   493	/// This is null when it isn't calculated. It is calculated on demand

   497	/// In order to make this more efficient, in many places where the value

  6290	///
  6291	/// This will return null if the point is out of bounds. The caller
  6292	/// should clamp the point to the bounds of the coordinate space if
  6293	/// necessary.
  6294	pub fn pin(self: *const PageList, pt: point.Point) ?Pin {
  6295	    // getTopLeft is much more expensive than checking the cols bounds
  6296	    // so we do this first.
  6297	    const x = pt.coord().x;
  6298	    if (x >= self.cols) return null;
  6299	
  6300	    // Grab the top left and move to the point.
  6301	    var p = self.getTopLeft(pt).down(pt.coord().y) orelse return null;
  6302	    // Incomplete reflow can leave a page narrower than the desired width.
  6303	    // Never manufacture an out-of-bounds pin for that page.
  6304	    if (x >= p.node.cols()) return null;
  6305	    p.x = x;
  6306	    return p;
  6307	}
  6308	
  6309	/// Convert the given pin to a tracked pin. A tracked pin will always be
  6310	/// automatically updated as the pagelist is modified. If the point the
  6311	/// pin points to is removed completely, the tracked pin will be updated
  6312	/// to the top-left of the screen.
  6313	pub fn trackPin(self: *PageList, p: Pin) Allocator.Error!*Pin {
  6314	    if (build_options.slow_runtime_safety) assert(self.pinIsValid(p));
  6315	
  6316	    // Create our tracked pin
  6317	    const tracked = try self.pool.pins.create(self.pool.alloc);
  6318	    errdefer self.pool.pins.destroy(tracked);
  6319	    tracked.* = p;
  6320	
  6321	    // Add it to the tracked list
  6322	    try self.tracked_pins.putNoClobber(self.pool.alloc, tracked, {});
  6323	    errdefer _ = self.tracked_pins.remove(tracked);
  6324	
  6325	    return tracked;
  6326	}
  6327	
  6328	/// Untrack a previously tracked pin. This will deallocate the pin.
  6329	pub fn untrackPin(self: *PageList, p: *Pin) void {
  6330	    assert(p != self.viewport_pin);
  6331	    if (self.tracked_pins.swapRemove(p)) {
  6332	        self.pool.pins.destroy(p);
  6333	    }
  6334	}
  6335	
  6336	pub fn countTrackedPins(self: *const PageList) usize {
  6337	    return self.tracked_pins.count();
  6338	}
  6339	
  6340	/// Returns the tracked pins for this pagelist. The slice is owned by the
  6341	/// pagelist and is only valid until the pagelist is modified.
  6342	pub fn trackedPins(self: *const PageList) []const *Pin {
  6343	    return self.tracked_pins.keys();
